Test Scenario: Verify user registration with valid details
Test Steps: 1. Go to registration page 2. Enter valid name, email, password 3. Submit form
Expected Result: Account is created and user is logged in

Test Scenario: Verify registration with an already registered email
Test Steps: 1. Go to registration page 2. Enter an email already in use 3. Submit form
Expected Result: System shows 'email already registered' error and does not create account

Test Scenario: Verify registration with weak/invalid password
Test Steps: 1. Go to registration page 2. Enter a password below minimum requirements 3. Submit form
Expected Result: System rejects the password and shows a validation message

Test Scenario: Verify login with valid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Go to login page 2. Enter registered email and correct password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is logged in and redirected to homepage

Test Scenario: Verify login with invalid password
Test Steps: 1. Go to login page 2. Enter registered email and wrong password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: System shows an error and access is denied

Test Scenario: Verify login with unregistered email
Test Steps: 1. Go to login page 2. Enter an email not in the system 3. Click Login
Expected Result: System shows an error and access is denied

Test Scenario: Verify password reset via email link
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Forgot Password' 2. Enter registered email 3. Open reset link from email 4. Set new password
Expected Result: User can log in with the new password
Notes: Test email service not configured in staging

Test Scenario: Verify browsing book catalog by category
Test Steps: 1. Go to homepage 2. Select a category from the menu
Expected Result: Books belonging to the selected category are displayed

Test Scenario: Verify search by book title returns correct results
Test Steps: 1. Go to homepage 2. Enter a valid book title in search bar 3. Press Enter
Expected Result: Matching book(s) are displayed in results

Test Scenario: Verify search by author name
Test Steps: 1. Enter a valid author name in search bar 2. Press Enter
Expected Result: All books by that author are displayed

Test Scenario: Verify search with no matching results
Test Steps: 1. Enter a keyword that matches no book 2. Press Enter
Expected Result: System displays a 'no results found' message, not an error
Notes: Blank page shown instead of a 'no results' message

Test Scenario: Verify viewing book details page
Test Steps: 1. Click on a book from search/catalog results
Expected Result: Book details page shows title, author, price, description, and availability

Test Scenario: Verify adding a book to cart
Test Steps: 1. Open a book's details page 2. Click 'Add to Cart'
Expected Result: Book is added to cart and cart count increases by 1

Test Scenario: Verify adding an out-of-stock book to cart
Test Steps: 1. Open the details page of an out-of-stock book 2. Attempt to click 'Add to Cart'
Expected Result: 'Add to Cart' is disabled or an out-of-stock message is shown
Notes: Out-of-stock state not yet implemented on staging

Test Scenario: Verify removing an item from cart
Test Steps: 1. Open cart with at least one item 2. Click 'Remove' on an item
Expected Result: Item is removed and cart total updates

Test Scenario: Verify updating quantity of an item in cart
Test Steps: 1. Open cart 2. Change quantity of an item 3. Apply update
Expected Result: Quantity and line total update correctly

Test Scenario: Verify cart total updates correctly after changes
Test Steps: 1. Add multiple books to cart 2. Update/remove quantities 3. Observe total
Expected Result: Cart total always reflects current items and quantities accurately

Test Scenario: Verify checkout with valid shipping and payment details
Test Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout with items in cart 2. Enter valid shipping address 3. Enter valid payment details 4. Confirm order
Expected Result: Order is placed successfully and confirmation is displayed

Test Scenario: Verify checkout with invalid/expired card
Test Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout 2. Enter an expired card number 3. Confirm order
Expected Result: System rejects payment and shows a clear error; order is not placed
Notes: Generic 'error occurred' message shown instead of a specific card error

Test Scenario: Verify order confirmation email is sent after purchase
Test Steps: 1. Complete a successful checkout 2. Check registered email inbox
Expected Result: Confirmation email with order details is received

Test Scenario: Verify viewing order history
Test Steps: 1. Log in as a user with past orders 2. Navigate to 'My Orders'
Expected Result: List of past orders with status is displayed

Test Scenario: Verify cart persists across sessions for logged-in user
Test Steps: 1. Add items to cart while logged in 2. Log out 3. Log back in
Expected Result: Previously added cart items are still present

Test Scenario: Verify page load time for catalog page
Test Steps: 1. Clear cache 2. Navigate to catalog page 3. Measure load time
Expected Result: Page loads within 2 seconds under normal conditions
Notes: Observed ~3.4s load time on staging (target is 2s per NFR-01)

Test Scenario: Verify checkout is blocked when cart is empty
Test Steps: 1. Ensure cart is empty 2. Attempt to navigate directly to checkout
Expected Result: User is redirected to an empty-cart message and cannot proceed to payment
